author: ilyass111
quote: I’ve played this game for over 5 hours, and the story is weak. The characters are terrible I couldn’t stand Lucia; it would have been better if she’d just stayed quiet. As for Jason, I’m literally at a loss for words I don’t even know what to say about him. Lucia abandoned your son without telling you, yet somehow that’s just brushed aside I still can’t wrap my head around it. On top of that, the missions are boring. This isn’t the game we know; it’s something else entirely, and in a bad way. Whoever wrote this story should be banned from ever writing one again. The only positive is that you can roam around, enjoy the world, and explore but as far as the story goes, I wouldn’t recommend playing it
